portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL9.6 crypto paes test failing when booting on S390  LPAR [rhel-10.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-103486)

* RHEL10.0 - s390utils/s390-tools: Add IBM z17 machine type definitions (JIRA:RHEL-90166)
